unit.description: Unit of measure (UN.) exactly as printed

quantity.description: QTD. column with exactly four decimals and a dot

unit_price.description: V.UNIT. column with exactly four decimals and a dot

ipi_rate.description: %IPI column (IPI rate) with two decimals and no percent sign; 0.00 when blank or zero

ipi_amount.description: V.IPI column (IPI amount) with two decimals; 0.00 when blank or zero

cnpj.description: CNPJ without punctuation: 12 alphanumeric characters plus 2 check digits
